== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Field Promotion]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.
